title: Judge verdict (harness-neutral)
description: The judge's decision on one PR head, the last JSON block of the judge session's final message. The runner turns a MERGE into a REJECT when a change with a null criterion is not marked unasked_ok with a why, into a HOLD when a marked one comes in a diff that changes a risk-tier path, and refuses a MERGE with an empty changes list or a criterion that does not quote the task.

verdict.description: HOLD: the diff makes a change no criterion asks for that cannot be judged safe or unsafe; the owner decides.

changes.description: Every behaviour change in the diff, including failure paths, defaults, limits, timers and changes to code or styles that other callers or pages share.

change.description: The change, quoting the diff line(s) that make it.

criterion.description: A word-for-word quote of the task criterion or spec requirement that asks for this change (never a proof command); null when nothing in the task asks for it.

unasked_ok.description: A null-criterion change that adds no new risk and fits the task's intent: it merges and is listed for the owner.

why.description: One line: why the unasked change is fine. Required with unasked_ok.

file.description: The changed file of an unasked_ok change. Shown in the HOLD reason; it never clears a change.
